epistemic_knowledge.note: Knowledge<T> with GUM uncertainty propagation, epsilon confidence, provenance tracking.

linear_types.note: linear struct enforces consume-exactly-once. No clone, no drop.

affine_types.note: affine struct: can be dropped but not cloned. Sub-structural control for optional resources.

effects_system.note: IO, Mut, Div, Panic, Alloc, Async, GPU, Prob, Observe.

closures.note: Lambda syntax |x: T| expr, multi-param, zero-param. Epistemic closures capture Knowledge<T> and auto-infer Epistemic effect.

algebra_system.note: algebra declarations with Fano-selective e-graph rewriting. Quaternion, Octonion, Clifford, G2 all supported.

observer_types.note: Unobserved<T> with Observe effect for quantum/Bayesian observation boundaries. Spencer-Brown UNMARKED/MARKED semantics.

ownership.note: Use-after-move and move-while-borrowed detected at compile time. Affine keyword + linear field propagation.

causal_types.note: Intervention<T> and Counterfactual<T> are compiler-level types. Stdlib DAG API (do_intervention, average_treatment_effect) exists.

refinement_types.note: Parser + type checker support refinement predicates. Static refinement engine (no SMT) is production; complex predicates fall back to runtime checks.

units.note: Compile-time dimensional analysis. Unit definitions, conversions, arithmetic.

ontology.note: 8 hardcoded CURIEs locally; 10K+ federated terms (planned L3/L4 integration). Subsumption and semantic distance working.

smt_prover.note: Static refinement engine (no SMT/Z3) is the production path. Fallback runtime checks with W040 diagnostic for complex predicates.

self_hosted.note: Fixed point achieved. gen2==gen3 bit-identical (243 MB ELF). v2.0.0 milestone.
